notes.title: Update 1 (Minor)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added in a deletion confirmation window for when players try to delete all saved games. This should act as another layer of protection against accidently deleting your saved games. 

[*] Updated help screen so that it explains how to skip cutscenes.
[/list]
